cross_cutting_finding: G20's two weekend-feeding Fridays sit on ONE structural configuration that separates cleanly into TWO channels, and the failure mode is reading either channel onto the other. (1) The SESSION is owned by the D-1 aggressor-flow exit, which is aligned-and-accelerating SELL on both (05-28 phase3 -3762 at phase_b 0.430; 06-04 -2682 then -2816 at phase_b 0.450 -> 0.436, the heaviest session of the block at -5662). (2) The SEAM is owned by the positioning/calendar stack, which is NOT the same on the two Fridays - and that asymmetry is the whole finding. The most striking fact in the block is that the market was handed two consecutive BULLISH storage misses (05-28 actual 92 vs consensus 96; 06-04 actual 95 vs 101) with the 5-yr surplus collapsing 98 -> 95 -> 86, and NET SOLD both print days. Bullish news rejected. selector.divergence_resolution resolves exactly this: gate (b) requires D-1 session_b_share >= ~0.50 for the bullish angle to earn an intraday lean, and it FAILS on both Fridays (0.458, 0.445), so the bullish channel earns AT MOST the reopen gap and no intraday day-lean. GENERAL and testable: (a) the big-print-minus-session b_share spread is NOT a discriminator in this regime - it is positive on 7 of 10 g20 sessions (mean ~+4pp) ahead of sell continuations, the mid-block bounce and the resumption alike, so a +6..+9pp spread must NOT be read as an absorption tell; the one instrument that did real work is flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard, because 05-25's 0.599 on 13 big prints is the ONLY reading in the block that clears 0.55 and the guard correctly disqualifies it - without the guard, structure.accumulation_arm_turn would have carried a spurious fire into the 0529 window. (b) WHEN TWO WEEKEND SEAMS FALL INSIDE ONE COT PUBLICATION CYCLE, THE WoW DELTA CANNOT BE SPENT TWICE. Both my seams are backed by the SAME report (05-26 positions, published Fri 05-29 15:30, MM net -134,426, 1y pctile 0.94, WoW -38,123). At the 05-29 seam that fuel is brand new and unfired; by the 06-05 seam it is 6.35 days old and the intervening tape shows it partly discharged (06-01 +3796 and 06-02 +3524, a +7,320 two-session buy burst) before shorts re-pressed. Reaching monday_bias UP at BOTH seams off one delta would be precisely the non-falsifiable double-count that positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate's falsifiability clause forbids and that E's own covering-give-back-is-self-limiting lesson (the G17 0424 miss) exists to stop. I therefore split them - and the thing that INDEPENDENTLY breaks the tie is calendar, not positioning: flow_calendar flips in_gsci_roll false -> TRUE with gsci_roll_day_n = 1 and in_bcom_hedge_roll TRUE on 06-05 exactly. A GSCI/BCOM index roll sells the front leg (NGN26 = my basis) and its WINDOW IS STILL OPEN on Monday 06-08, which daytype.friday_exit_decomposition's own sub-rule calls positioning-CARRY, not spent. So: 0529 seam = roll-free, COT prior unopposed -> monday_bias UP. 0605 seam = mechanical roll supply in my own leg across the whole following week -> monday_bias DOWN with the squeeze as a named upper tail. Two weekend-feeding Fridays, near-identical exits, OPPOSITE seam verdicts, from a decidable open-time discriminator.

handoff_out.verbatim_read: Monday 06-01 inherits a session that went down but STOPPED going down, into a weekend, holding a one-year record short that was published at 15:30 with the market still open. Do not inherit the Friday LABEL, inherit the STATE: a four-session sell run at the block's flow extreme, a close in the lower quartile but off the low, and an unfired maximal crowded short. Size the seam GAP first and separately from the intraday - the gap is the extension-independent part and it is UP; the intraday is extension-gated, and because the inherited extension is a DOWN extreme, a counter-move off it is the LOW-extension case for the up leg, so the intraday can EXCEED the gap rather than round-trip to it (the G19 0511 shape, not the 0518 shape). Do not front-run it into Friday's own close - the p50 for 05-29 is DOWN and the up-prior is a SEAM object. And do not read my 'off the low' close as exhaustion of the sell: exhaustion is a positive claim and the COT WoW delta bars it here. What I could NOT give you, and you should get first: the 05-29 last-hour SIGNED FLOW (masked to me), which is the covering-vs-squaring discriminator; and the realized cum_from_anchor, without which nobody downstream may assert a chain polarity.
